BillingStatus.description:
The job's hold on your balance. `held`: the estimate is reserved. `settled`: the
actual cost was charged and the rest of the hold returned. `released`: the whole hold
was returned and nothing was charged.
BillingStatus.title: BillingStatus

ErrorCategory.description:
Who or what stopped a job: `rejected` (an admission rule, such as the balance),
`circuit` (your circuit or job parameters), `vendor` (the vendor) or `internal` (the
router).
ErrorCategory.title: ErrorCategory

ErrorCode.description: A stable error code. Branch on the code, never on the message.
ErrorCode.title: ErrorCode

JobError.description:
Why a job failed or was rejected. `code` is the error code and `category` says who
or what stopped the job: `rejected` (an admission rule, such as the balance),
`circuit` (your circuit or job parameters), `vendor` (the vendor) or `internal` (the
router). Branch on `code` for logic and on `category` for display.
JobError.title: JobError

JobStatus.description:
The status of a job. `queued`: accepted, not yet running at the vendor. `running`:
the vendor is running it. `completed`: the result is available. `failed`: the vendor
or the router could not produce a result, and `error` says why. `cancelled`: the job
was cancelled, normally at your request. `rejected`: refused before it reached the
vendor, and `error` says why. `completed`, `failed`, `cancelled` and `rejected` are
terminal.
JobStatus.title: JobStatus

Method.description:
What the job computes. `run`: one expectation value per observable. `sample`:
measurement counts. `probabilities`: the probability of every basis state.
`zero_state_probability`: the probability of the all-zeros state.
Method.title: Method

description:
A job, as `POST /v1/jobs` and `GET /v1/jobs/{job_id}` return it. Amounts are
integers in micro-USD: 1000000 is $1. An IBM Quantum job is free on the router:
`billing` and the cost fields stay null and `estimate_usd_micro` is 0.

actual_cost_usd_micro.description: What the job cost you: null while `billing` is `held` or null, the charged amount once `settled`, and 0 once `released`.
actual_cost_usd_micro.title: Actual Cost Usd Micro

billing.description: The job's hold on your balance. Null when no hold was ever placed, as for an IBM Quantum job or a job rejected for the balance.

completed_at.description: When the job reached a terminal status. Null until then.
completed_at.title: Completed At

credential_source.description: `own`: the job ran on the IBM Quantum account you connected. `organization`: Reserved. Null for an Amazon Braket job.
credential_source.title: Credential Source

error.description: Why the job failed or was rejected. Null for any other status.

estimate_usd_micro.description: The job's estimated cost at submission, in micro-USD. A job that is charged has a hold of this amount placed on your balance.
estimate_usd_micro.title: Estimate Usd Micro

fee_usd_micro.description: The EigenOrbit fee inside `actual_cost_usd_micro`. Null until `billing` is `settled` or `released`.
fee_usd_micro.title: Fee Usd Micro

ibm_usage_seconds.description: The IBM quantum time the job used, in seconds with millisecond precision, as IBM reports it. Null until IBM reports it, and for an Amazon Braket job.
ibm_usage_seconds.title: Ibm Usage Seconds

price_version.description: The price version the job was admitted with, for example `braket/sv1@1`.
price_version.title: Price Version

result_expires_at.description: When the job's result and request are, or were, deleted. Set once the job is terminal and null while it runs. The job itself, with its status and costs, stays readable after the deletion.
result_expires_at.title: Result Expires At

vendor_cost_usd_micro.description: The vendor's cost inside `actual_cost_usd_micro`. Null until `billing` is `settled` or `released`.
vendor_cost_usd_micro.title: Vendor Cost Usd Micro
